name: Subaru Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Subaru Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in the maintenance and cleaning of roads and road ancillary facilities in Japan. The company is also involved in the contracting for maintenance, cleaning, repair work, and related facilities; operation of expressways and highway shops; and operation and management of marinas, cafes, and restaurants. In addition, it engages in the solar power generation business; restaurants and café management services; installation and sales of vending machines; sale of foodstuffs and drinking water, as well as sales of alcoholic beverages and disaster prevention goods; marina operation business; and real estate leasing activities.
